run_execute_code: run a Python script in a sandboxed subprocess with RPC access to Hermes tools
build_execute_code_schema: build the function-calling schema for the execute_code tool with enabled tools and mode
generate_hermes_tools_module: generate the hermes_tools.py RPC stub module for local UDS or remote file-based transport
check_sandbox_requirements: check if the code execution sandbox is available on the current operating system
run_remote_code: run a Python script on a remote terminal backend via file-based RPC with polling thread
